title: AFF Object Type Metadata
description: Machine-readable metadata for an ABAP File Format object type folder

objectType.description: The ABAP object type covered by this folder

name.description: ABAP object type code (e.g. CLAS, INTF)

description.description: Human-readable description of the object type

group.description: Object type group (e.g. Source Code Library, Dictionary); omit when the object type has no group

version.description: Format version number, matching the formatVersion of the JSON files and the -v<version> suffix of the JSON schema

deprecated.description: True when this version is superseded by a newer one

filePattern.description: File name pattern, following the file name specification: <name>.<objtype>[.<sub name>.<sub type>][.<content type>][.<language>].<extension>. The known placeholders are <name> for the object name, <lang> for the language, <fmname> for the function module name and <csnfilename> for the CSN file name

cardinality.description: Number of files of this type per repository object

schema.description: Relative path to the JSON schema that validates this file (omit for non-JSON files)

definitionInterface.description: ABAP interface name that defines the JSON structure (e.g. zif_aff_clas_v1)

definitionUrl.description: URL to external documentation for non-JSON files (ABAP syntax reference etc.)

examples.description: Relative paths from the folder root to example files
